parsed.note_claim: No nationwide ban on Discord exists in the Philippines.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: Editor's Note: This article was updated to clarify that the extension of the CICC's ultimatum to open a PH office only covers Reddit and not Discord, as later clarified by the agency.
parsed.reason: The page clarifies that the government ultimatum risking a ban does not apply to Discord, substantiating the note's claim that no nationwide ban exists.
